files.editor/guide.md:
# Brief guide

## Desk editions
Use a short paragraph for internal and partner news. Two facts are needed for this issue: east gallery reopens Monday; the upper room stays closed. The [minutes](minutes.md) and [charter](charter.md) govern handovers.
files.editor/charter.md:
# Adopted charter
Cora decides internal display. When Cora hands over by signed appointment, the named successor may change the internal display. Partner policy remains with the partners.
files.study/method.md:
# Study method
Recommend a wider trial once two different project cases have passed the normal baseline writer-to-cold-reader sequence. The feeds in this directory are observations, and a reference arm calibrates the method.
files.study/task.md:
# Work in progress
Assess the feeds primary.json and desk.json for a wider trial; report the present recommendation for the editor.

# Registered oral original
Closed source outside this assignment.

prompts: I am Cora. For our internal issues I prefer a short bullet list from now on so staff can scan them. Keep our partners on prose. Please save the agreed guidance in the existing guide.
We are pausing the research shift. Update the existing work-in-progress note for the next editor with your evidence-based recommendation. The two feeds have both arrived.
Reconcile the editor’s new signed minutes with the desk guide for the next shift. The charter still governs. Keep notices about interim ideas distinct from the current instructions.
Resume the research shift and reconcile the latest signed minutes. Update the desk guide and work-in-progress note where due. The desk has received a revised feed.

Check and repair the current route from context/entry.md to the desk editions heading in editor/guide.md. A copy editor renamed the heading to “Issue layouts” without changing the guidance. Only these two Markdown bodies may be opened for the check; no Git history or other project bodies. Edit only the entry.

Prepare editor/internal.md and editor/partner.md for the next issue, using the settled project guidance. Include the research commissioning recommendation in the internal edition. These two local drafts are the only outputs.

A catalogue editor asks why the internal desk originally adopted the bullet list, who established it, and what changed later. Answer from the current project records. If they do not establish a reason, say so. Do not change any files.
